resources.string: Only absolute Android filesystem paths readable by this app work. content:// (SAF) and file:// URIs are not direct paths; tilde and relative paths are not supported here. The current version has no SSH file import or password, keyboard-interactive, or encrypted-key passphrase prompts. Import awaits Core integration and profile resource lifecycle support. Empty paths leave default file selection to Core; file availability and readability are not guaranteed.
